extraction.Name: Ellen Grinnell (Baker)
extraction.Cancelled: Request was made under date of October 5, 1928, for the cancellation of the fee patent (L-S 30017-28).
extraction.Refused/Protested: No protest was made as she thought the land restricted property.
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded with the County by notice from this district by the district tax assessor.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: No part of the land has been sold or mortgaged.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Taxes have been assessed against the land since 1920. Not paid.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Her husband supports the family. He is employed in the Indian Service in the position of Stockman.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 715287; Allottee No. 191, 1073, and 270a; Receipt of patent was never acknowledged by patentee; Patent mailed to Superintendent Ft. Berthold Nov. 14, 1919, no receipt in files of this office; Mrs. Baker is the mother of eight children, five of whom are allotted, not dependent on her for support; husband is Louis Baker, stockman in the Independence District; she has received fee patents for her other allotments; not defrauded of her property.
